'''Kevin Staley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Vancouver tournament (18 March)]] on 18 March 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|My Kind of Scum]], according to David Houle's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1938">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-23-vancouver-b-c-03-18-01d1938/ vancouver-b-c-03-18-01], DeckTech (David "TAZ" Houle, 23 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-23-vancouver-b-c-03-18-01d1938/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
